# stb

`stb_image.h` (v2.30) and `stb_image_write.h` (v1.16), by Sean Barrett and contributors, from https://github.com/nothings/stb. They are public domain, or MIT at your choice; the licence text is at the end of each file.

They are used by `tools/cli/image_io.cpp` to read image files and write PNGs: in the command-line tool and the hallway, and, for the vault's check of files that are pictures, the installer. The core library does not depend on them.
